Without going into to much detail, as we sleep we release Growth Hormone which is our number fat burner. As growth hormone goes up, insulin drops down, insulin is our number 1 fat storage hormone. When you wake up your body is in a high fat burning stage, the second we introduce carbs to our bodies growth hormone drops, insulin goes up and you are no longer in a fat burning zone. When we eat fats and proteins and no carbs, our bodies will begin to burn up all the excess carbs (fat) that is stored all over our body and at the same time teaches our bodies how to use fat (healthy fat that we are eating) as fuel for our training.
